title: Tests that pass or fail on clock speed become outcome checks, then CI caps return to measured
why: Owner, Nov 1 18:44 CST: "we have a step regarding fixing CI that eliminates time limits and instead ensures outcomes based testing". No step did this (searched c34, c39, c128, test-ci-standard, tci-7, tci-8; gap found by tci-12). Generous job caps are a stopgap until it lands (decision ci-job-caps).
note:
Coordinator pick, 13:32 CST Nov 7 (undoable, logged for the owner): the test finder lists a per-test time cap (test-cap) as a hang guard but does not count it, per the owner's 13:00 CST ruling. 0 test-caps in the repo today. Home: decision test-practices P5 in #1177, marked as the coordinator's reading.
Owner, chat 13:00 CST Nov 7 (item 345, none of the options): P5 never meant to ban timed waits. Timed tests are allowed, and catching a hung test is a good reason for one. A time-based test is often wrong or unneeded; when one is needed, it uses a synthetic clock so local load cannot affect it. So: convert each speed-dependent wait to a synthetic clock, and keep hang guards. Decision test-practices P5 is rewritten to the owner's words in #1177 (lane cs-revive-unfinished).
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): steps time-pinned-{banchi,cs,degen,ios-adblock,joyous,mailaudit,qmax} merged here.
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): PARTIAL: #1147 and #1177 are open. Not live: no lane and no open PR.
In q_max, banchi, degen, joyous, mailaudit and ios-adblock (home through its own lane): find tests that pass or fail on wall-clock speed (real sleeps, fixed timeouts that assert speed, runner-speed caps inside tests) and replace each with an outcome check (fake clock, wait for a condition), per decision test-strategy-reset. Then return each repo's job caps to measured figures, closing the ci-job-caps stopgap. Done check: a per-repo list of time-pinned tests found, each replaced or recorded as a debt, and caps re-measured. Port: yes, every repo with CI. Ready. Part 1 in draft PR #1026 (batch runner 7), Nov 1 21:08 CST: finder lint/find_time_pinned.py and docs/plans/time-pinned-tests.md with per-repo counts and file lists. Found: q_max 326, banchi 357, degen 1346, joyous 41, mailaudit 319, ios-adblock 1; home unscanned (held). Part 2, the per-repo lanes, starts after #1026 merges. Part 2 steps, one per repo: time-pinned-qmax, -banchi, -degen, -joyous, -mailaudit, -ios-adblock, -cs (claude-settings: 238). home: none until it is scanned.
